landing.badge: Multi-tenant review pages for local businesses
landing.headline: Boost Your Google Reviews Automatically
landing.description: Give every cafe, salon, clinic, gym, or hotel its own smart review page. Happy customers go to Google, unhappy customers go private on WhatsApp.
landing.supportTitle: One SaaS, many businesses, clean /r links for every location.
landing.supportBody: Each business gets a unique review page, direct QR destination, business-type suggestions, and a lightweight dashboard to track review intent.
landing.featureOneBody: Create direct links like /r/cafe-xyz or /r/salon-abc and turn them into printable QR codes instantly.
landing.featureTwoBody: Cafe, salon, clinic, gym, and hotel pages all show different review suggestions so the flow feels tailored.
landing.featureThreeBody: Manage many businesses in one fast dashboard without bloated setup or heavy infrastructure.
landing.detailTitle: Three simple steps from scan to social proof
landing.stepOneBody: Add the business name, choose the type, and the app generates a clean review slug automatically.
landing.stepTwoBody: Customers land directly on /r/[slug], making the flow simple, fast, and mobile-friendly.
landing.stepThreeBody: Positive visitors go to Google, private feedback goes to WhatsApp, and review suggestions match the business type.
landing.finalTitle: Launch each client page in under a minute.
landing.finalBody: Start with cafes, salons, clinics, gyms, or hotels and keep the whole product lightweight enough to deploy fast.

review.subheadlineWithType: Happy customers can go public. If something felt off, private WhatsApp feedback goes straight back to this {{type}}.

review.photoStepTitle: Add a photo to help others discover this place
review.photoStepBody: Photo reviews feel more real, help this business stand out, and often look more helpful to future customers.
review.photoStepProofTwo: A quick photo can make your review stand out
review.photoIdeasBody: Pick any simple moment while it is fresh. No need to make it perfect.

review.comboBody: Use one of these short review lines after you add your photo.
review.suggestionsBody: Tap any suggestion to copy it before opening Google.
